note: Official Tunisian secondary maths chapters, scientific sections only. Order and titles follow the CNP textbooks (tables of contents read on sigmaths.net on 2026-11-17); content cross-checked with the official programmes (Sept. 2005 for 1ère/2ème, Sept. 2006 for 3ème/4ème). Titles lightly normalised: 'IR' written ℝ; the missing set symbol in 'Divisibilité dans' read as ℕ (3ème, programme: division euclidienne dans ℕ) and ℤ (4ème, programme: congruence dans ℤ); 4ème Sc. info chapter 14 ('Probabilité' in the book) named 'Variables aléatoires'. 2ème Sciences and Technologie de l'informatique share one programme and one textbook. topics are short hints, not the full programme. skills link existing skillMap ids by the chapter that teaches them. Not reviewed by a teacher.
